contract: Actionable alt-data axis for the Mastermind bot. Each signal: signal_score 0-100 (composite of weighted convergence + brain conviction + price confirm − extension), action ∈ {ACCUMULATE,WATCH,AVOID}, direction ∈ {long,short,neutral}, source ∈ {brain,deterministic}. The bot sizes through its OWN risk framework; this is an input, not an order. Brain calls are graded vs SPY (see calibration). An extended name is never ACCUMULATE. trump_linked / affiliations flag actor ties. rolling_over names (off_high≤−15% AND 20d<0 AND below 50dma) appear in broken_signals only — crowd attention, NOT entries. entry_tier (T1/T2/T3) = validated confluence buy gate signal.
regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in AI compute, memory and cloud platforms, with NVDA showing the broadest independent alignment and MU/MSFT offering cleaner second-order exposure. Signals remain provisional because the desk has no scored history, while social sentiment, affiliations and lobbying are supporting rather than decisive evidence.

calibration.note: No theses scored yet — the track record begins once the first check-by dates pass. Keep conviction modest until it does.

signals.thesis: MSFT has multi-channel alignment across app demand, open-source activity, patents and lobbying, supported by its factual partnership with Sam Altman [app_demand] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [lobbying] [actor:Sam Altman]. These signals collectively point to durable AI-platform engagement, but the absence of institutional-flow or insider-buying confirmation keeps conviction low.
second_order: NVDA — cloud AI usage can translate into accelerator demand.
MU — expanding cloud inference and training require additional memory.
AI power and data-center infrastructure — cloud capacity growth increases physical-infrastructure requirements.

falsifier.text: App demand and developer momentum weaken together without evidence of continued AI-platform adoption.

signals.thesis: PLTR shows a narrow but coherent convergence around government and retail momentum: accelerating federal contracts (+19% [gov_contract_accel]), a pro-Trump 'buy' signal [trump], strong retail buzz (91 WSB mentions, 0.79 stocktwits bull ratio [retail_buzz, stocktwits_bull]), and a disclosed stake by political influencer Marjorie Taylor Greene [actor:Greene]. The government contract acceleration is a tangible, near-term revenue indicator. With a 60d RS of +13.3, the name is approaching heat-check territory but is not flagged as extended; the thesis is best played on a pullback given its momentum-driven character.
second_order: BA: Both thrive on defense/security spending; BA's gov grant acceleration (+30%) and patent cluster support a broader defense-digitization theme [gov_grant_accel, patent_cluster].
MSFT: PLTR's FedRAMP and government AI deployments often run on Azure, making MSFT a quiet beneficiary of PLTR's government contract wins [affiliation].

falsifier.text: PLTR fails to convert the accelerated gov contracts into reported revenue growth in the next quarter, or its WSB/Stocktwits buzz fades without a corresponding price catalyst, leading to momentum reversal.

signals.thesis: The pack's strongest convergence combines institutional adding, dark-pool accumulation, analyst upgrades, developer momentum and a large patent cluster [13f_add] [darkpool_accum] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster]. Disclosed holdings by Nancy Pelosi, Marjorie Taylor Greene and Michael McCaul add an influence-graph confirmation, although they do not establish causality [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. The shares are not extended versus SPY, so the entry constraint does not block an overweight; earnings in 20 days create event risk as well as a validation point [earnings_metric].
second_order: MU — AI-compute deployment implies greater demand for memory capacity.
LITE — continued data-center scaling can support optical-connectivity demand.
AI power and data-center infrastructure — compute deployment requires additional power, cooling and physical capacity.

falsifier.text: Dark-pool accumulation reverses and the next earnings update fails to sustain the demand narrative.

signals.thesis: BA shows a modest but diversified alignment across government-grant acceleration, insider purchase intensity and patent activity [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster]. Pending FY2027 defense authorization activity provides a broad sector backdrop, although the pack does not tie the legislation directly to BA [bill:HRES1438]. Jim Cramer's endorsement and bullish social sentiment are weak supporting signals only [actor:Jim Cramer] [stocktwits_bull].

Defense-electronics theme — FY2027 defense activity may support adjacent program suppliers.
Advanced-manufacturing theme — BA's patent activity implies ongoing demand for specialized engineering inputs.

broken_signals.thesis: QCOM is a deep-value, multi-channel convergence case: a net-positive congressional buy signal (6 net, 2 members [congress_buy]), a massive patent cluster (559 patents [patent_cluster]), and an affiliation signal. The stock is deeply washed out (rs_vs_spy_60d -24.8), which creates a potential mean-reversion setup. The catalyst lens adds a 'special situation' tag, likely tied to the semiconductor sector's legislative tailwinds. The low weighted score (1.55) reflects few channels, but those present are high-quality (Congress buying a washed-out patent leader). This is a 'wait for a floor' watch, not a chase.
second_order: AAPL: QCOM's modem and IP are deeply tied to Apple's supply chain; a QCOM recovery implies healthy smartphone demand, benefiting AAPL [patent_cluster].
MSFT/NVDA: A recovering semiconductor/IP sector sentiment broadly lifts all AI and cloud-enabling semiconductor names [affiliation].

falsifier.text: QCOM loses a significant portion of Apple's modem business or issues a negative pre-announcement, leading to a new leg down in price that congress members may have failed to anticipate.

disclaimer: An AI reading of the desk's own deterministic convergence — accountable and checkable, not a guarantee. Every call cites the channels/actors it is based on, is graded vs SPY over the horizon, and can be wrong or overconfident. The Mastermind sizes it through its own risk framework; treat as odds, not a forecast.
